intro: Raene's Cleansing begins when Raene Wolfrunner asks an adventurer to track down her missing friend, Teronis. Seeking a way to halt the rampant furbolg aggression across Ashenvale, Teronis set off toward Lake Falathim to recover a magic gemstone.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in Ashenvale, but he has yet to return.
He had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard.
Before he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod.
He mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. The gem was being held there before it was overrun.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.
The deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.
